group.name: NotaryChain
group.description: NOTARYCHAIN is the world’s first blockchain-based notary platform to notarize and verify documents electronically and remotely. Built on top of enterprise-grade blockchain technology, the platform offers enhanced security (tamperproof), speed, convenience, and instant verification of notarized documents. The private notary public can to sign-up on the platform and notarize documents remotely, safely, and in a timely manner.
